# Data contract

What the application stores, and the exact shape of every file and endpoint.
If you are setting up data for the first time, read **`setup-guide.md`** first —
this document is the reference, not the walkthrough.

---

## 1. The database

**`data/app.db`** — SQLite. Generated by `data/scripts/build_db.py`; it is
**not** committed to git. Delete it and re-run the script at any time.

### `departments`

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | TEXT | Primary key. Feeds the login dropdown. |

### `employees`

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `email` | TEXT | Primary key. Always stored lower-case. |
| `name` | TEXT | Full name, shown in the header and the suggestion list. |
| `department` | TEXT | Must exist in `departments`. |
| `photo` | TEXT | Optional filename under `assets/img/avatars/`. `NULL` falls back to initials. |

### `chapters`

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | 1–4. |
| `slug` | TEXT | e.g. `safe-account`. |
| `opens` | TEXT | `YYYY-MM-DD`, inclusive. |
| `closes` | TEXT | `YYYY-MM-DD`, inclusive. |
| `has_content` | INTEGER | `0` locks the chapter with "Coming soon". |

### `attempts`

One row per completed play. Never updated, never deleted — the history is the
record.

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | Autoincrement. |
| `email` | TEXT | → `employees.email`. |
| `chapter_id` | INTEGER | → `chapters.id`. |
| `attempt_no` | INTEGER | **Computed server-side** as the user's previous count for that chapter, plus one. Clients must not send it. |
| `score` | INTEGER | Points earned. |
| `max_score` | INTEGER | Points available that run. |
| `duration_s` | INTEGER | Seconds taken. Nullable. |
| `language` | TEXT | `en` or `vi` — which language the user played in. |
| `detail` | TEXT | JSON, per-game breakdown. |
| `played_at` | TEXT | ISO-8601 UTC. |

### `chapter_exits`

Records that a user spent their one-off "grace" play by leaving a closed
chapter without retrying. Primary key `(email, chapter_id)`, so it can only
ever be burned once.

---

## 2. Derived values

**Best score** for a user in a chapter is `MAX(score)` across their attempts —
a worse retry never replaces a better run.

**Average score** (the KPI tile) is the mean of every participant's *best*
score per chapter, expressed out of that chapter's maximum. Retries cannot drag
the average down.

**People completed** counts distinct emails with at least one attempt.

---

## 3. The API

All responses are JSON. All errors carry an `error` string.

### `GET /api/employees?q=<term>`

Login autocomplete.

```json
[ { "email": "minh.cs@pg.com", "name": "Minh Cao Sy" } ]
```

> The department is **deliberately absent**. Exposing it here would let the
> browser reveal the answer to the department check.

### `GET /api/departments`

```json
["Communications", "Finance", "Human Resources", "..."]
```

### `GET /api/kpis`

```json
[
  { "key": "completed", "value": "1",     "pct": 6,  "sub": { "n": 18 } },
  { "key": "plays",     "value": "1",     "pct": 4 },
  { "key": "avg",       "value": "4.0/5", "pct": 80 }
]
```

`pct` drives the thin progress bar on each tile.

### `GET /api/records?email=`

That user's attempts, newest first. Powers the **My records** drawer.

```json
[ { "chapter_id": 1, "attempt_no": 1, "score": 4, "max_score": 5,
    "duration_s": null, "language": "en", "played_at": "2026-10-03T07:12:44+00:00" } ]
```

### `GET /api/chapters?email=`

The lock verdict for every chapter, for this user.

```json
{
  "today": "2026-10-03",
  "chapters": [
    { "id": 1, "slug": "safe-account", "opens": "2026-10-01", "closes": "2026-10-08",
      "hasContent": true, "state": "available", "reason": "open",
      "best": null, "plays": 0 }
  ]
}
```

`state` is one of:

| `state` | `reason` | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `upcoming` | `not-open` | The window has not started |
| `available` | `open` | Inside the window |
| `grace` | `last-chance` | Window closed, but this user never played — one final play |
| `locked` | `window-closed` | Window closed and the user already played |
| `locked` | `grace-used` | The final play was used or abandoned |
| `locked` | `no-content` | `has_content = 0` |

The browser **must not** decide this itself; it renders whatever the server says.

### `POST /api/auth/verify`

```json
{ "email": "minh.cs@pg.com", "department": "Human Resources" }
```

→ `{ "ok": true, "user": { "email": "...", "name": "...", "department": "...", "photo": null } }`

or `{ "ok": false, "error": "email-not-found" }`
or `{ "ok": false, "error": "department-mismatch" }`

### `POST /api/attempts`

```json
{ "email": "...", "chapter_id": 1, "score": 5, "max_score": 5,
  "duration_s": 214, "language": "en", "detail": { "phish": 1, "sort": 1 } }
```

→ `{ "ok": true, "attempt_no": 2 }`

### `POST /api/chapter/exit`

```json
{ "email": "...", "chapter_id": 1 }
```

Burns the grace play. Idempotent. Sent with `navigator.sendBeacon` so it
survives the page unloading.

---

## 4. Content files

### `public/content/games/chapter-NN.json`

Every mini-game for one chapter. **Bilingual in place** — each piece of text is
an object with `en` and `vi`. There is no separate English file; a missing `vi`
falls back to `en`.

```jsonc
{
  "chapter": 1,
  "maxScore": 5,
  "games": [ /* one object per game, played in order */ ]
}
```

Common fields on every game:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Short key used in the `detail` JSON of an attempt |
| `type` | `hotspot` · `sort` · `story` · `trap` · `quiz` |
| `points` | Points this game is worth |
| `title`, `intro` | `{en, vi}` shown on the game's start card |

#### `type: "hotspot"` — spot the phishing

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `image` | Path relative to `public/` |
| `timeLimitS` | Seconds before the game ends itself |
| `hotspots[].rect` | `[x1, y1, x2, y2]` as **fractions of the image, 0–1** |
| `hotspots[].label` | `{en, vi}` — listed as the player finds each one |
| `hotspots[].why` | `{en, vi}` — teaching note shown beside a sign once found |

Scores its point only when **every** hotspot is found.

#### `type: "sort"` — safe or unsafe

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `statements[].text` | `{en, vi}` |
| `statements[].zone` | `"safe"` or `"unsafe"` — the correct answer |
| `zones.safe.label` / `.hint` | `{en, vi}` for the left target |
| `zones.unsafe.label` / `.hint` | `{en, vi}` for the right target |
| `fallSeconds` | How long each card takes to fall |

Scores its point only when **all** statements are sorted correctly.

#### `type: "story"` — branching story

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `slides[].speaker` | `{en, vi}` — who is talking |
| `slides[].scene` | `{en, vi}` — the situation |
| `slides[].question` | `{en, vi}` |
| `slides[].options[]` | `{ en, vi, correct, fbEn, fbVi }` |

Every slide is shown regardless of the answer — a wrong choice explains itself
and still moves on. The point is awarded only if **all** slides were answered
correctly. Option order is shuffled each play.

#### `type: "trap"` — the password trap

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `prompt`, `placeholder` | `{en, vi}` |
| `submitLabel`, `cancelLabel` | `{en, vi}` |
| `emptyWarning` | Shown if the box is empty — the user cannot bypass it |
| `failTitle`, `failBody`, `failNote` | Shown when a password is submitted |
| `winTitle`, `winBody` | Shown when the user cancels |

**Security:** the game reads only `value.length` to decide whether the box is
empty, then clears the field. Nothing typed is transmitted, stored or logged,
and `failNote` says so to the user explicitly.

Cancelling scores `points` (2). Submitting scores nothing **and zeroes the
whole chapter**.

### `public/content/questions/chapter-NN.json`

The classic quiz format, used as a fallback when a chapter has no games file.

```jsonc
{
  "chapter": 2,
  "questions": [
    {
      "id": "q1",
      "text": { "en": "...", "vi": "..." },
      "options": [ { "en": "...", "vi": "...", "correct": true } ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### `public/content/i18n/{en,vi}.json`

Flat key → string. Placeholders use `{name}` and are substituted at render
time. **Both files must contain exactly the same keys** — a key present in only
one language will render as the raw key when that language is active.

---

## 5. Browser session

`sessionStorage["csm_user"]` holds `{ email, name, dept }` after a successful
login. It is cleared on sign-out and when the tab closes. It is a convenience
cache only — every gate is enforced by the server.
